title: 第2027章 狠人女帝危第2026章 我要单挑陆玄
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: “轰隆！”
“轰隆！”
一道道金色的纹路开始交织了起来，星空之中仿若有一只无形的大手正在编织。
并没有沿用此前的空间阵纹。
这是崭新的阵纹！
张奎统领等人一脸震惊。
“这是何等品阶的阵纹？”
他们可是道尊境，但竟然看不透阵纹的跟脚。
他们感应到阵纹似乎会呼吸！
和这一片星空互相呼应。
其阵基屹立星空深处，延绵千万里，无比璀璨。
和过去的空间大阵相比，这简直就是艺术品！
无数星辉如同流水一样奔涌，隐隐有天地异象，上古宫阙，还有巨鼎的虚影浮现。
那些星点化作了恢弘的星链，纵横交错，化作浩瀚阵网。
漫天星华如同瀑布一样垂落了下来，瑞光四起。
壮哉！
张奎统领等人惊呼了起来。
这个阵纹自然比不上中央星域，当年蝶月老祖亲自布下的阵纹。
当绝对是他们见过前三的阵纹！
气势如龙，如虎，周天齐齐轰鸣。
不多时。
这一片空间通道，被金光覆盖，崭新的阵纹已经形成了。
“凑活吧。”
陆玄淡淡说道。
这阵纹，可以说是鼎足意志的衍化。
其实是有些粗糙的。
但奈何太初母气鼎品阶太多，它的意志力量也极为浩瀚。
所以，最终形成的阵纹乃是道尊阶！
张奎统领等人再次震惊。
这等级别的大阵，在陆尊主的眼中，只能算是“凑活”。
陆尊主太强大了。
这时，陆玄查看了一下系统面板。
姚曦女皇，杨坚那里的情况，一目了然。
那里也爆发了大战。
以现在狠人女帝，杨坚的实力，还不足以获胜。
毕竟杨坚只是道生境，而那里的敌人道灭境都有不少！
念及此，陆玄拉起小囡囡的手，“走，我们去大昌星域。”
他现在的真实修为已经是五星道生境初期。
再加上两个鼎足的权柄之力！
在山鼎界，他可以灭杀低星道尊境！
content_en:
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
Golden lines began to intertwine, as if there was an invisible big hand weaving in the starry sky.
The previous space formation pattern was not used.
This is a brand new formation pattern!
Commander Zhang Kui and others looked shocked.
"What kind of formation pattern is this?"
They were in the Taoist realm, but they couldn't even see through the formation's heels.
They sensed that the array pattern seemed to be breathing!
Echoing this starry sky.
Its formation base stands deep in the starry sky, stretching for thousands of miles, and is extremely bright.
Compared with the previous space arrays, this is simply a work of art!
Countless stars surged like running water, and there were faint visions of heaven and earth, ancient palaces, and the phantom of a giant cauldron emerging.
Those star points turned into a magnificent star chain, criss-crossing and turning into a vast array network.
The stars all over the sky fell down like a waterfall, and auras of light arose everywhere.
How magnificent!
Commander Zhang Kui and others exclaimed.
This array pattern is naturally inferior to the array pattern laid out by Patriarch Dieyue himself in the Central Star Region.
It must be that they have seen the top three formation patterns!
The momentum is like a dragon or a tiger, and the whole sky is roaring.
Not long after.
This space passage is covered in golden light, and a new array pattern has been formed.
"Just make do with it."
Lu Xuan said lightly.
This formation pattern can be said to be the evolution of tripodzu's will.
It's actually a bit rough.
However, there are too many grades of the Taichu Mother Qi Cauldron, and its will power is also extremely vast.
Therefore, the formation pattern finally formed is the Taoist level!
Commander Zhang Kui and others were shocked again.
In the eyes of Lord Lu, a large formation of this level can only be regarded as a "make-do".
Lord Lu is too powerful.
At this time, Lu Xuan checked the system panel.
Queen Yao Xi, the situation at Yang Jian's place is clear at a glance.
A war broke out there too.
With the current ruthless empress, Yang Jian's strength is not enough to win.
After all, Yang Jian is only in the Dao Life Realm, and there are many enemies there who are in the Dao Destruction Realm!
Thinking of this, Lu Xuan took the little girl's hand and said, "Let's go to the Dachang Star Territory."
His current true cultivation level is already at the early stage of the five-star path.
Plus the power of two tripods!
In the Shanding Realm, he can kill the low-star Taoist Realm!
title_en: Chapter 2027 The ruthless empress is in danger Chapter 2026 I want to challenge Lu Xuan alone
